title: Point-system Roos transport interfaces
statement: For the finite field, prime and coefficient conventions of def-trf-coefficient-conventions, package the existing strict coefficient-system functors, normalized full-tower Roos models, canonical products, their derived comparisons and the six transport law predicates. The structure Data consists of Models, Products, ProductLaws, Comparisons, ComparisonLaws and TransportLaws. This is the unchanged interface formerly attached to lem-trf-point-system-roos-transport; its exact-products theorem uses lem-trf-point-system-normalized-comparison-data.

source.place: Step 1, Global powers: base-change isomorphisms at stage E are rationalizations of the integral ones; prerequisite prop-trf-rational-frobenius-integral-model proof (3), integral maps are derived limits of levelwise composites; extracted old item steps 5-6. Agent-formulated refinement of the explicit inverse-image and point-transport recipes; not a verbatim theorem of the blueprint. Interface extraction and assembly subclaim from the existing whole-Roos argument.

proof.text: All definitions are the original explicit definitions. The previously proved exact_products assertion is the corresponding conjunction projection from PointSystemNormalizedComparison.exact_products; no new data are chosen from an existence theorem.

proof_origin.place: Existing whole-Roos refinement; coordinate construction, strict restriction, or derived cancellation as stated in the Lean docstring.
